#AI labels
Laws in some regions may require you to label ads that use certain assets created or edited with AI. Learn more about labeling requirements in AI regulations: https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/17140115
You can label assets from the Asset library tab of the Asset studio page or by editing your campaign's settings after upload.
If you prefer, you can also label assets before you upload them. Google may label your assets in some cases, such as when Google itself is legally required to do so, or when we get signals to do so from other platforms.
